annotation.title_clean: IEEE 7000-2021 IEEE Standard Model Process for Addressing Ethical Concerns during System Design
annotation.title_en: IEEE 7000-2021 IEEE Standard Model Process for Addressing Ethical Concerns during System Design
annotation.authors_or_issuer: IEEE Standards Association (C/S2ESC Software & Systems Engineering Standards Committee)
annotation.summary_en: IEEE SA catalogue page for IEEE 7000-2021, a standard model process for addressing ethical concerns during system design. It sets processes for eliciting and prioritising ethical values with stakeholders and tracing them into requirements and risk-based design. Also lists the adopted IEEE/ISO/IEC 24748-7000-2022.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes processes to include ethical values throughout concept exploration and development
Supports stakeholder engagement for ethical value elicitation and prioritization
Requires traceability of ethical values into concept of operations, ethical requirements and risk-based design
Applicable to organizations of all sizes and life cycle models
